Exchanges.Text:
Hello, Payments (Demo) team—welcome to today’s standup.
Our sprint goal is that Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically, with 6 days left in the sprint.

Daniel, quick check-in: is the idempotency keys work for story 4 done, and is the summary page work for story 3 done as well?
And is the structured logging for task 15 finished, and have you been able to help Maya Lin with bug 12 on sandbox gateway timeouts?
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.
Noted: yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.
Who can help unblock the summary page work, which is waiting on the idempotency keys in?
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.
Daniel, noted: that's everything from you, and you'll pick up the summary page after the idempotency keys are in.

Thanks, Daniel.
Maya, quick update: for bug 12, did the staging access pairing you mentioned get finished? For story 5, are the PCI scan exception follow-ups and the security review chase done, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline and I’ll add this to the parking lot. Maya, please carry on with what you were saying.
That's everything from me.
Maya, who can help unblock the sandbox gateway timeouts and access to the platform team’s staging gateway?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

I've noted your commitment: Pair with him on staging access today.
story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.

Noted, Maya: blocker: The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.; commitment: The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today..

Noted, Maya: blocker: The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.; commitment: The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today..
Thanks, Maya. Admin, quick update: did you finish the payment retry story 1 you mentioned, and is task 14 done; what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.
Admin, note: Yesterday I finished the refund API tests, and today I’m still working on the payment retry story with no blockers.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Thanks, everyone.

Recap, and I’ll keep it quick: bug 12 is still blocking Maya, and the sandbox gateway timing out is tied to access to the platform team staging gateway. The summary page work will resume once idempotency keys are in. PCI scan exceptions are waiting on a security review, and follow-ups are coming in Teams.

Pinned for offline follow-up: task 19 and task 15, as noted. The owners will get a follow-up. Thanks again.
